'''Bar Ras''' was a [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who was convicted of stealing from and assaulting a neighbor. Ras was the first individual to be punished with the [[Nocombackie law/Legends|nocomeback law]] instituted by [[Boss/Legends|Boss]] [[Rugor Nass/Legends|Nass]].<ref name="TCSWE" />
